title: Freeze-Credit Days on a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Calculation memo — freeze-credit days, Self-Pay Visit Package.** The freeze-credit days by which the expiry date moves out when a package is unfrozen are worked out in this order: first the freeze days are counted, then the count is limited to the paid-up stretch, then it is capped; nothing is added to or subtracted from the capped freeze days, and the freeze-credit days never go below zero.

**1. Counting the freeze days.** The freeze days are the calendar days from the freeze start date to the unfreeze date, the freeze start date itself not counted — that is, the difference between the two dates. The freeze start date is the one recorded on the package; the unfreeze date is the day the freeze is lifted.

**2. The paid-up stretch.** The expiry extension on unfreezing is fixed only after the package's history carries an installment payment for every installment whose due date has passed; while one does not, the freeze days are limited to the days from the freeze start date to the due date of the first unpaid installment.

- An installment's due date has passed when it falls on or before the unfreeze date; the due dates are the purchase date, and then the purchase date plus the tier's installment interval in calendar days for every earlier installment, up to the number of installments the package's price is paid in.
- The first unpaid installment is the one after the installments already paid; its due date is the purchase date plus the installment interval for every installment already paid.
- Where the limit applies, the freeze days are the lower of the counted freeze days and the days from the freeze start date to that due date, and never below zero.
- A package paid in full at the sale carries its one installment payment and is not limited.

**3. The cap.** The credited freeze days never exceed the freeze cap, which is the tier's maximum freeze length.

**Worked figure (hypothetical package: purchase date day 0, 2 installments 30 days apart, a maximum freeze length of 45 days, freeze start day 20, unfreeze day 70)**

| Step | Both installments in the history | Only the first installment in the history |
|---|---|---|
| Freeze days counted (day 20 to day 70) | 50 | 50 |
| Installments whose due date has passed (day 0, day 30) | 2, both paid | 2, one paid |
| Paid-up stretch | not limited: 50 | limited to day 20 to day 30: 10 |
| Capped at 45 | 45 | 10 |
| Freeze-credit days | 45 | 10 |
